a: Singleton ensures a class has only one instance with a global access point.
Factory creates objects without exposing the exact class to the caller.
Observer lets objects subscribe to events and get notified on changes.
MVC separates Model (data), View (UI), and Controller (input/logic).
RESTful design models resources with nouns and uses HTTP verbs for actions.
DRY: Don't Repeat Yourself — avoid duplicating knowledge/logic.
KISS: Keep It Simple, Stupid — prefer simple solutions.
SOLID: Single responsibility, Open-closed, Liskov, Interface segregation, Dependency inversion.
A pure function returns the same output for the same inputs and has no side effects.
Immutable data is not changed in place; updates create new values (safer concurrency).
Debounce delays handling until events stop firing for a quiet period (e.g. search input).
Throttle limits how often a function runs during continuous events (e.g. scroll).
Memoization caches function results for repeated inputs to avoid recomputation.
Recursion uses function calls and a stack; iteration uses loops. Both can solve many problems.
Off-by-one errors are boundary mistakes (loops, indexes, inclusive/exclusive ranges).
Null safety means the type system or checks prevent unexpected null/None access.
